'''Harkas Korrd''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] officer in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]], where he was killed. The thought of his brother dying due to running out of supplies prompted his younger brother [[Seeral Korrd]], to specialise in logistics.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Colonel Korrd}}</ref>
